P.name: Mark of the Kindred
P.title: Template:Data Kindred/Mark of the Kindred
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Mark of the Kindred|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Kindred |skill = I |icon = Mark of the Kindred.png |icon2 = Lamb's Mask profileicon.png |icon3 = Wolf's Mask profileicon.png |blurb = {{sbc|Innate:}} Both {{ci|Lamb}} and {{ci|Wolf}} mark targets to ''hunt''. Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''hunted'' target collects a permanent stack of ''Mark of the Kindred''. '''Lamb''' can select an enemy {{tip|champion}} to ''hunt'', and '''Wolf''' automatically selects a large {{tip|monster}} to ''hunt''. |blurb4 = {{sbc|Mark of the Kindred:}} '''Lamb''' gains {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}''. For each stack, {{cis|Kindred}} abilities become more potent. |description = {{sbc|Innate:}} Both '''Lamb''' and '''Wolf''' mark targets to ''hunt''. Scoring a {{tip|takedown}} against a ''hunted'' target collects a stack of ''Mark of the Kindred''.

{{sbc|Mark of the Kindred:}} '''Lamb''' gains {{pp|type=marks|75;100;125;150;175;200;225;250|4;7;10;13;16;19;22;25|formula=+75 at 4 stacks, and +25 every 3 stacks thereafter, up to 250 bonus range at 25 stacks.}} {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} on her basic attacks and ''{{ai|Mounting Dread|Kindred}}''. |description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Lamb:}} '''Lamb''' is offered a selection of enemy {{tip|champions}} to ''hunt'' if she has not been [[combat status|in combat]] with them in the last 6 seconds. Once selected, the mark is applied after an 8-second delay and thereafter it can be collected by '''Kindred'''. '''Lamb''' gains the ability to select a new target every 75 seconds. ''Targets successfully hunted cannot be marked again for 4 minutes.'' |description3 = {{sbc|Innate - Wolf:}} Starting at {{sbc|2:53}}, '''Wolf''' periodically marks a random large {{tip|monster}} within the enemy team's jungle for 180 seconds. The ''hunted'' camp is highlighted on the [[Map (League of Legends)|mini map]] to both teams. Once the ''hunted'' target is slain or the mark expires, '''Wolf''' will wait 45 seconds before selecting a new target.
The type of monster that '''Wolf''' can mark changes based on '''Kindred's''' current ''Mark of the Kindred'' stacks: * {{sbc|0 :}} {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} * {{sbc|1 – 3:}} {{ui|Rift Scuttler}}, {{ui|Crimson Raptor}}, {{ui|Gromp}} * {{sbc|4 – 7:}} {{ui|Ancient Krug}}, {{ui|Blue Sentinel}}, {{ui|Greater Murk Wolf}}, or {{ui|Red Brambleback}} * {{sbc|8 + :}} {{ui|Rift Herald}} or {{ui|Baron Nashor}}, {{ui|Dragon}} or {{ui|Elder Dragon}} |ontargetcdstatic= {{tt|240|Lamb's mark}} |targeting = Passive |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = |spellshield = |spelleffects = |projectile = |grounded = |knockdown = |notes = * The selection of enemy champions to mark is offered through a special menu in the HUD that displays the portraits of up to 5 enemy champions. The player can mark an enemy by {{LMB}} clicking on their portrait or via the Champion Specific Interaction [[hotkey]]s (default: {{sbc|Shift}}+{{sbc|F1–F5}}). ** Marked enemies have a trim around their portrait. Unavailable selections are greyed out. ** The portraits are ordered based on their spawn ID. * {{tip|Takedown|Takedowns}} on {{tip|monsters}} occur if '''Kindred''' had damaged them within the last 6 seconds. ** This only includes if the monster was slain by '''Kindred''' or an ally. * Only killing the large monster is required to claim '''Wolf's''' mark. * Gaining stacks from champions that would change what constitutes a valid target for '''Wolf''' will not affect '''Kindred's''' ability to claim '''Wolf's''' current target. * '''Wolf''' cannot mark monsters that have been slain, even if '''Kindred's''' team doesn't know that the camp has been slain. * '''Wolf's''' cooldown is not displayed in-game. Combined with the above point and the target restrictions, '''Wolf''' may go extended periods of time without seeming to do anything. * '''Wolf's''' marked target will always have its mark removed from the map 15 seconds after dying for both teams, regardless of whether they have vision of it or not. |flavorsound = {{sm2|Kindred_Original_P_Mark_Enemy_10.ogg}} ''"Our mark looms over you."'' }}

W.name: Wolf's Frenzy
W.title: Template:Data Kindred/Wolf's Frenzy
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Wolf's Frenzy|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kindred
|skill        = W
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} As {{ci|Kindred}} move and attack, they build up stacks of ''Hunter's Vigor''. At full stacks, {{cis|Lamb}} next basic attack {{tip|heals}} her.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Wolf}} {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and occupies the area for a period. He attacks enemies within the area, dealing {{as|magic damage}}. Against {{tip|monsters}}, '''Wolf's''' attacks deal increased damage and {{tip|slow}} the target for a short time.
|blurb3      = ''Wolf's Frenzy'' ends immediately if '''Lamb''' leaves the area or dies.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Lamb''' generates 1 stack of ''Hunter's Vigor'' for every {{tt|27 units|Estimated}} she travels by any means and 5 stacks {{tip|on-attack}}, up to a maximum of 100 stacks. At maximum stacks, her next basic attack {{tip|heals}} her for {{as|{{pp|0 to 100 by 25|0 to 80|formula= 1.25% per 1% of '''Kindred's missing''' health. ''This is capped at 80% '''missing''' health.''|label1='''Missing''' health|type='''Kindred's''' '''missing''' health|label=Percent of level-scaling value|key=%|key1=%|changedisplay = true}}}} of {{pplevel|47 to 81|color=heal}}. The heal is not triggered if '''Kindred''' is at full health.
|icon2        = Wolf's Frenzy.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Wolf''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location, then claims the surrounding area as his territory for the next {{fd|8.5}} seconds, separating from '''Lamb'''. He automatically attacks the closest nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within the area, prioritizing the last enemy '''Lamb''' has attacked, then enemy champions, then non-champions.
|description3 = '''Wolf's''' attacks deal {{as|magic damage}} and the rate at which he attacks scale with {{as|25% of '''Kindred's bonus''' attack speed}}. Against monsters, his attacks deal 150% damage and {{tip|slow}} the target by 50% for 2 seconds. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{fd|112.5}} {{as|(+ 15 per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} against monsters.
|leveling3    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|25 to 45}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% {{as|(+ 1% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}|Monster Damage|{{ap|25*1.5 to 45*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|1.5*1.5}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*1.5}}% per {{ai|Mark of the Kindred|Kindred|mark}})|buzzword}} of target's '''current''' health)}}}}
|description4 = ''Wolf's Frenzy'' ends immediately if '''Lamb''' leaves the area or dies.
|target range = 500
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 800
|speed        = 1400
|cast time    = none
|cooldown     = {{ap|18 to 14}}
|cdstart      = on-cast, see notes
|cost         = 40
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|projectile   = False
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* ''Hunter's Vigor's'' heal is not triggered on attacks against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
* '''Wolf''' is {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} but he cannot move through terrain other than the initial dash on activation. 
* '''Wolf''' is not able to re-target {{ui|Rift Scuttler}} if he loses {{tip|sight}} of her while he's attacking it.
* '''Wolf''' grants the same {{tip|sight|vision}} as a {{tip|champion}}.
* ''Wolf's Frenzy'' does not end if '''Lamb''' enters {{tip|resurrection}}.
* ''Wolf's Frenzy'' applies ability haste to its cooldown post-effect.
** Given a base cooldown of 14 seconds at rank 5 with 100 ability haste, casting the ability and then ending it after 4 seconds will result in a remaining cooldown of <math>(14 - 4) \times 0.5 = 5</math> seconds, where 0.5 is [[Haste#Formula|derived from ability haste]].
** Because of this, there will always be some cooldown time remaining post-effect regardless of the amount of ability haste, unlike certain other abilities with cooldowns that start on-cast.
* {{Pending for test}}: Interaction with enemy vision and spectator mode.
|tips =
* '''Wolf''' can be used to get {{tip|sight|vision}} over walls.
}}

R.name: Lamb's Respite
R.title: Template:Data Kindred/Lamb's Respite
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Lamb's Respite|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Kindred
|skill        = R
|icon         = Lamb's Respite.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Lamb}} blesses the ground under herself for a few seconds. Any unit inside the area will become {{tip|invulnerable}} upon reaching {{tip|minimum health threshold|low health}}.
|blurb2       = Units within the area are {{tip|heal|healed}} when the blessing ends.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Lamb''' blesses the ground underneath herself, creating a sacred zone at the location that lasts for 4 seconds. {{tt|'''All''' units|Ally, enemy, and neutral}} inside the zone gain a {{tip|minimum health threshold}} equal to {{as|{{sti|health|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}, and will also become {{tip|invulnerable}} while remaining in the area when they reach or are at the threshold, during which they also cannot be {{tip|heal|healed}}, but can still {{sti|health regeneration|regenerate health|link=health regeneration}}.
|description3 = All targetable units within the zone are {{tip|heal|healed}} when the blessing ends.
|leveling3    = {{st|Heal|{{ap|225 to 375}}}}
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 535
|cooldown     = {{tt|{{ap|160 to 120}}|Begins at start of cast time}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self, Allies, Enemies
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* ''Lamb's Respite's'' effects are applied before the cast time.
* ''Lamb's Respite'' will affect all {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|minions}}, and {{tip|monsters}}, but not {{tip|ward|wards}}, {{tip|turret|turrets}}, or [[jungle plants]].
* ''Lamb's Respite'' will affect {{tip|untargetable}} units but does not grant them the {{tip|heal}} at the end of the blessing.
** It will specifically not affect champions that are {{tip|resurrection|resurrecting}} from {{ii|Guardian Angel}}.
* {{tip|Health resource|Health costs}} will ignore ''Lamb's Respite's'' threshold.
** The cost will not be paid if the caster is below the threshold.
* ''Lamb's Respite'' has no effect on {{tip|zombie state}} or {{tip|clone}} units.
* {{pending for test}} ''Lamb's Respite'' will have no effect if cast while '''Kindred''' is {{tip|untargetable}}.
| flavorsound = {{sm2|Kindred_Original_R_1.ogg}} ''"Shine once more, before the end."''
}}
